title: Intent to task, measured
body:
Outcome: for one week of operator rows in the inbox, the share that became a task, the share whose task closed done, and the time from the prompt to the merge, joined by hand from the "Operator requests" lines of the handoffs.
Why: the brief's first step has no record: nothing joins a prompt to a task. The tracker alone shows 200 of 533 tasks closed other than done, 187 in one triage on 11-07 and 3 of the 164 created since **[V]**; two of the three are intent losses (`t-jzdybq2`, `t-ps3ap2e`), which is a cleared backlog and a first sample, and says nothing about prompts that never became a task.
Proof: a table; if every operator row of the week has a task and at most one in ten is still open after a day, the slice closes with that answer and nothing is built. Otherwise the task records which field (an origin on the task, or a task id on the inbox row) would have made the join mechanical.
Scope: a script under `scripts/claude/`, read-only.
Order: B1, B2, B3; then the two measurements B6 and B7; B4 when the operator adds the line; B5 last.
Order: after B2.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice B7.
